Social exclusion and poverty
Equal Treatment Bench Book – July 2024 (February 2026 update) 195
Community sentences and treatment orders

63. Non-custodial sentences can also have a negative impact on the chances of retaining
employment. Socially excluded people often have complex and even chaotic lives which can
make it difficult to attend regularly, as directed.
Financial penalties/repayments of benefit

64. Self-evidently, the impact of a £100 fine is greater for someone whose weekly income is £60
than for someone whose weekly income is £600. The offender will also be required to pay a
surcharge (used to fund victim services).
